## Crates

- [admin](/architecture/crates/admin) — RegelRecht admin UI for viewing pipeline database
- [auth](/architecture/crates/auth) — RegelRecht shared OIDC/SSO authentication
- [corpus](/architecture/crates/corpus) — RegelRecht corpus client - Git integration for the regelrecht-corpus repository
- [editor-api](/architecture/crates/editor-api) — RegelRecht editor API — lightweight Axum server for the law editor frontend
- [engine](/architecture/crates/engine) — RegelRecht law execution engine - Machine-readable Dutch law execution
- [harvester](/architecture/crates/harvester) — RegelRecht law harvester - Download Dutch legislation from BWB repository
- [law-model](/architecture/crates/law-model) — RegelRecht canonical law-YAML document model - the single Rust representation of the law format
- [pipeline](/architecture/crates/pipeline) — RegelRecht pipeline - Job queue and law status tracking for the processing pipeline
- [shared](/architecture/crates/shared) — RegelRecht shared types - Canonical domain types used across crates
- [tui](/architecture/crates/tui) — RegelRecht TUI dashboard for law execution, testing, and monitoring
